title: BOSGAME E5 11 Pro Mini PC, AMD Ryzen 5300U 4C/8T
writeup: This BOSGAME E5 is a small Windows 11 Pro desktop for office work, browsing and a home server or router box. BOSGAME lists a Ryzen 3 5300U (4 cores, 8 threads, up to 3.8GHz), two 2.5GbE ports and an extra M.2 slot. A SFFMetric lab test of a 16GB unit measured 2.37 Gbps over LAN and about 8W idle. It is the Prime price, $199.49. The Ryzen chip dates to 2021, and the 16GB tested ran single-channel, so graphics are limited. Check the memory size selected on the listing.
